slides.texte_overlay:
signs you're an old soul
in a young body

you love quiet evenings

a calm night in with a book, tea and an old film sounds far better than a loud party. you've always felt most like yourself when the world slows down around you.

old things fascinate you

old letters, vintage records and forgotten history pull you in. you feel strangely at home with things that have a story behind them and have survived a long time.

you never stop learning

old souls are endlessly curious, and they learn something new about the world every single day: an ancient myth, a forgotten empire, a distant star. curiosity has always felt like home to them.
slides.texte_sophia:
you never stop learning

i've always felt like an old soul. i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, ancient history or a forgotten myth, and it feels like home every single time.

slides.texte_overlay:
you prefer deep talks

small talk drains you, but a conversation about life, meaning or the stars can keep you up all night. you'd rather have one real friend than twenty casual acquaintances.

you notice what others miss

you see the beauty in an old building, a sunset or a kind gesture that everyone else walks past. noticing small things has always felt natural to you, never like effort.
